parts.title: If 100 people were to watch tiktok for 15 minutes, how much energy would be used?
parts.description: That's 25 hours of total watch time.

choices.text: Enough to power the average apartment for 2 hours.
Roughly the same as charging an electric car.

parts.response-html:
With 2.5 kWh of electricity, you can charge the average smartphone approximately 130 to 160 times!

100 people watching TikTok for 15 minutes equates to around 1.5 to 4.5 kWh of energy. In Norway, according to elvia.no, the average apartment uses roughly 10 899 kWh per year. 10 899 kWh a year is equal to ~ 2.5 kWh every 2 hours.Read more about this subject

parts.title: How much more energy does streaming in 4K UHD (2160p) use compared to 720p HD?
parts.description: 4K has three times the vertical pixel count of 720p
parts.response-html:
The amount of data transfered while streaming grows exponetially based on video quality.

A 4K UHD frame consists of ~ 8.3 million pixels, while a 720p HD frame only consists of ~ 0.9 million pixels. 4K offers over a nine times increase in resolution compared to 720p. As a consequence, 4K also uses around nine times more energy then 720p.Read more about this subject

parts.title: How much more energy does a ChatGPT request use compared to a regular Google search?
parts.response-html:
A single ChatGPT request uses roughly the same amount of energy as charging a smartphone for 3 minutes.

A Google Search only looks for information and provides a response based on what it found, while ChatGPT needs to generate a response from scratch using massive neural networks that require significant computational power.Due to the fundamental difference in their approach, ChatGPT uses approximately 10—20 times more energy then performing the exact same search on Google.Read more about this subject

parts.title: Why does a simple ChatGPT request use far more energy than a normal Google search?

choices.text: AI models use a lot of computation to generate answers, while Google mainly retrieves pre-indexed results.
Google only uses renewable energy, while OpenAI only uses fossil energy.
ChatGPT is a newer system, and hasn't had the time to fully optimize it's energy consumption.
Because ChatGPT stores and processes each request individually, while Google reuses cached answers from previous searches.

parts.response-html:
AI models like ChatGPT run billions of parameters through powerful computers for each response.

Large language models run on very powerful, but also very energy hungry datacenters. These datacenters use a lot of resources on not just running the computers, but also for cooling and managing them. In comparison, search engines like Google only need to find pre-indexed information, which is way more efficient than generating a new answer every time.Read more about this subject
